cards.audioText: Your callsign is CSN3102, a B737 from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are now at gate 127 with information F. You are ready to copy ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方3102，从广州飞往北京的波音737，你现在在127停机位，收到通播F，你准备好抄收管制放行了。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Delivery, CSN3102, Guangzhou to Beijing, gate 127 with information F, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州放行，南方3102，广州飞往北京，127停机位，收到通播F，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, Guangzhou Delivery, standby due thunderstorm en route.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，广州放行，由于航路上有雷暴，稍等。

cards.audioText: You want to know how long the delay will be.
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Delivery, CSN3102, confirm how long the delay will be.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州放行，南方3102，证实延误时间。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, delay not determined, call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，延误不确定，等会叫你。

cards.audioText:
[A few minutes later.]
C: CSN3102, are you ready to copy your ATC clearance?
[Tell the controller "Yes".]
cards.audioTextZh:
【几分钟后】
南方3102，你准备好抄收你的放行许可了吗？
【告诉管制员，是的】
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，准备好抄收了，南方3102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, here is your ATC clearance. Cleared to Beijing via LMN-81 departure, flight planed route, cruising level 9800m, initial climb to 900m on QNH1012, runway 02L, squawk 1725, departure frequency 121.05.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，这是你的管制许可，可以经由LMN-81标准离场飞往北京，计划航路，巡航高度9800米，初始爬升至900米，修正海压1012，跑道02左，应答机编码1725，离场频率121.05。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via LMN-81 departure, flight planed route, cruising level 9800m, initial climb to 900m on QNH1012, runway 02L, squawk 1725, departure frequency 121.05, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由LMN-81标准离场飞往北京，计划航路，巡航高度9800米，初始爬升至900米，修正海压1012，跑道02左，应答机编码1725，离场频率121.05，南方3102。

cards.audioText: You are now ready for push back and start-up.
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN3102, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方3102，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN3102, pushback and start-up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，可以推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing east, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，面朝东，南方3102。

cards.audioText: CSN3102, taxi via L8, A, A10 to the holding point of runway 02L.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，经由滑行道L8，A和A10滑行至跑道02左等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via L8, A, A10 to the holding point of runway 02L, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道L8，A和A10滑行至跑道02左等待点，南方3102。

cards.audioText: You are now approaching holding point of runway 02L and you are ready for departure, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达跑道02左外等待点，你准备好起飞了，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, holding point of runway 02L, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方3102，跑道02左外等待点，请求离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, hold short for wake turbulence, a heavy B747 just departed.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，由于尾流，原地等待，一架重型747刚刚起飞。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, wind 040, 03m/s, fly runway heading, cleared for takeoff runway 02L, report airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，风向040，3米每秒，跑道航向，可以起飞，跑道02左，离地后报。
cards.referenceText: Runway heading, cleared for takeoff runway 02L, wilco, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向，可以起飞，跑道02左，照办，南方3102。

cards.audioText: You are now airborne and have passed 1200m, contact Guangzhou Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在离地了，过1200米，联系广州离场。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN3102, airborne runway 02L, passing 1200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，南方3102，离地了，跑道02左，过1200米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 088, track direct to CON, climb to and maintain 2100m when passing CON.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，北京离场，雷达识别了，右转航向088，直飞CON，过CON后上2100米保持。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 088, track direct to CON, climb to and maintain 2100m when passing CON, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向088，直飞CON，过CON后上2100米保持，南方3102。

cards.audioText: Now you are cruising at 9800m. During the cabin service, you encountered moderate turbulence, a flight attendant accidentally spilled hot water on a female passenger. Though timely first aid has been given, the passenger's condition has not improved. Inform the controller this situation and request fly back and land at Guangzhou airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在9800米巡航。在客舱服务期间，你遇到了中度颠簸，一名乘务员不小心将热水洒到一名女乘客身上。虽然已经实施了急救，但是乘客的情况并没有改善。告知管制员此情况，请求飞回广州机场。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3102, cruising at 9800m, we encountered moderate turbulence, a flight attendant accidentally spilled hot water on a female passenger during cabin service, first aid has been given, the passenger's condition has not improved, request return to land at Guangzhou airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方3102，9800米巡航，我们遇到了中度颠簸，一名乘务员不小心将热水洒到一名女乘客身上。虽然已经实施了急救，但是乘客的情况并没有改善，请求返回广州机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, roger, turn left heading 280, descend to and maintain 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，收到，左转航向280，下到8400保持。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 280, descend to and maintain 8400m, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向280，下到8400保持，南方3102。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3102, medical team will be ready upon landing, do you require other assistance?
[Tell the controller you want disembark passengers at the apron, so you need passenger stairs.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3102，医疗队伍将会在着陆后就位，你还需要其他协助吗？
【告诉管制员你想在机坪让乘客下飞机，你需要客梯。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request passenger stairs to disembark passengers at the apron, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求客梯来让乘客在机坪下飞机，南方3102。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CSN3102, passenger stairs will be ready.
